stages.title: 01 · Production workspace
stages.detail: The live pilot finished before this recording. This walkthrough reads actual saved results; it queues no AI jobs.

stages.title: 02 · Grouped navigation
stages.detail: Banking operations, Reporting & assurance, Administration and Resources separate daily work from system tasks.

stages.title: 03 · Synthetic intake
stages.detail: Only synthetic or public evidence belongs here. No import is submitted in this results walkthrough.

stages.title: 04 · Payouts, not one-to-one payments
stages.detail: Payments are aggregated into payouts; Python integer arithmetic establishes financial findings.

stages.title: 05 · Financial evidence first
stages.detail: This stored operational case shows fee, net, currency and timing checks. It is separate from synthetic evaluation fixture IDs.

stages.title: 06 · Actual controlled-v2 pilot
stages.detail: 12/12 accepted; 72/72 closed claims supported. One development example per family; this is not a holdout score.

stages.title: 07 · Measured usage and latency
stages.detail: 24 requests; 44798/4722 input/output tokens; p50/p95 2869/6299 ms. Estimated USD 0.05484750.

stages.title: 08 · No observed pilot failures
stages.detail: No provider, schema, unsupported-claim or policy failure appeared in these 12 cases. This does not establish a zero production failure rate.

stages.title: 09 · Original fee report
stages.detail: Fixture 200101: expected fee 94,593 USD minor units; observed 94,672; difference 79. The model cites payout and policy evidence.

stages.title: 10 · Missing evidence means abstain
stages.detail: Fixture 200703 lacks payout.gross. The original model response says INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, abstains and escalates.

stages.title: 11 · Conflicting records stay visible
stages.detail: Fixture 200800 retains the stored-rule conflict and 731 VND difference. It abstains and escalates instead of choosing a convenient record.

stages.title: 12 · Simultaneous findings
stages.detail: Fixture 200901 preserves late settlement, a 41-cent fee difference and a 127-cent amount difference; escalation is required.

stages.title: 13 · Scope of the result
stages.detail: Both required abstentions and all four required escalations were correct. Six injected-note cases passed; broad prompt-injection safety is unmeasured.

stages.title: 14 · Historical benchmark preserved
stages.detail: Raw-v1 remains 18/48 (37.5%). It tests diagnosis from raw evidence; v2 is rule-guided compliance, so the scores are not directly comparable.

stages.title: 15 · Independent human review
stages.detail: Maker-checker remains enforced by the server. This read-only recording submits no recommendation, approval or financial change.

stages.title: 16 · Durable audit evidence
stages.detail: Evaluation start/completion events are persisted. The original workflow video separately records analyst and supervisor escalation.

stages.title: 17 · Administration stays separate
stages.detail: Worker visibility and controls live outside banking tasks. No service control is changed for this recording.

stages.title: 18 · Reviewer handoff
stages.detail: The earlier workflow video is retained. This results walkthrough, complete pilot JSON and measured report will be added alongside it.
